note: Trinidad and Tobago: a non-national may work without a work permit for 30 days once in any one year, declaring it to the immigration officer on entry (the Housing Minister to the Senate, under the Immigration Act; taken as 30 within 365); beyond that the Ministry of National Security's work permit. CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states work on the Skills Certificate (the csme list).

sources.title: Stabroek News (from the Trinidad Guardian), Non-nationals may work up to 30 days per year without permit in Trinidad
sources.said: Non-nationals can come into this country – as long as they declare to the Immigration officer – and they can work without a work permit for 30 days. They can do so for once in any one year.
